defects: G1 MINOR voice2txt/context.py:188-211 (_late_watch) with :244-249: the watcher identifies the 'target late write' only by GetClipboardSequenceNumber, so any single clipboard write inside LATE_GRACE+settle is reverted to the saved text. (a) No selection: Ctrl+C in an app with nothing selected writes nothing, so every no-selection 隨便問 takes the 'late' path; a single user copy 1.0 s after return was reverted to the pre-ask text 2/2 (C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\b51f5512bc03461d\387748d2-868b-4f3b-b7d3-186341f655fa\scratchpad\d1\nosel.json). (b) A user copy within 0.15 s (merge) of a target's late write is reverted 2/2. Both contradict USER_MANUAL.md:130 '這段時間內你自己另外複製了東西則不會動它' and STATUS.md:60 '使用者在這段時間另外複製則不動剪貼簿'. Low probability (the user is usually holding the hotkey and speaking) and recoverable, but the documented guarantee is false. Suggested fix: before restoring, require GetClipboardOwner's process id to equal the target window's process id (or document the residual).

G2 MINOR voice2txt/context.py:170 + voice2txt/desktop.py:852-854: because no selection is indistinguishable from a late target, every 隨便問 without a selection now waits ~0.9 s (was <=0.4 s) before recording starts and shows '選取文字擷取逾時，未取得選取；剪貼簿將在目標回應後自動還原' (auditor: 3/3 no-selection captures returned in 0.906-0.922 s with reason 'late'). The message is spec-mandated (T23 item 4) but misleading for the most common ask case, and USER_MANUAL.md:130 describes it only for slow apps. Stale: desktop.py:657 docstring still says '約 0.4 秒'.

G3 MINOR scripts/check_context_capture.py:91: the delayed 700 ms scenario forces capture_selection(timeout=0.4) instead of the product default 0.9, and verification/context-capture-2026-11-13.json does not record the timeout used (only capture_seconds 0.422). STATUS.md:60 places that evidence next to '約 0.9 秒', implying the default path. With the default 0.9 s a 700 ms target is captured normally (auditor 3/3); the watcher at the default timeout was verified by the auditor with a 1000 ms target (3/3), so behaviour is fine but traceability is not.

G4 MINOR scripts/check_wave_d.py:184-262 (cross_process_check): selection_obtained false in 2/17 runs. Instrumented failing run 14: capture_selection WAS entered (fg_before == target hwnd 11997446), the EDIT child logged WM_KEYDOWN 'C' without Alt, its text was unchanged afterwards, but the clipboard sequence did not advance (9553 -> 9553) within 0.907 s -> ('', False) 'late'; clipboard_restored_after_capture true. This refutes the T23 executor note that failures happen without entering capture_selection. The same native EDIT target driven without the App/hook captured 60/60 (max 0.063 s). Root cause not determined (target did not copy in time under App+hook+injected F23 repeat); the product behaved per T23 (honest 'late', clipboard intact). Not a proven product defect; the check remains flaky.
